title: Open a local project
responsibility: Asks the desktop connection to open a project folder, navigates to its branch’s pages, and refreshes the available-project list.

inputs.name: openProject.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace the function updates: it reads `bridge`, writes `selection.id`, `busy` and `error`, and calls `navigate` and `loadProjects`. If `bridge` is falsy, the function returns at once without changing `busy` or `error`; otherwise it sets `busy` to `true` and clears `error` to an empty string before calling `bridge.openProject()`.

outputs.name: openProject
outputs.description: Resolves with no value once the function finishes, after `busy` is set back to `false` if an attempt started. A truthy bridge result sets `selection.id` to its `project.id` (or `null` when missing), navigates to the pages path for that id and its `revision.branch`, then calls `loadProjects`; a falsy result skips those steps, and any failure in the attempt is stored as `String(cause)` in `error` rather than rejecting.
